title: STRling Standard Library Registry
description: Single-source-of-truth manifest mapping pattern names to their AST, documentation, citations, and completion-trigger keywords. Consumed by the language-intelligence core and propagated to all editor surfaces (hover, completion, signature help).

patterns.name: email
patterns.summary: Matches the canonical structure of an email address (addr-spec).
patterns.documentation: Matches `local@domain.tld` where the local part allows letters, digits, dot, underscore, percent, plus, and hyphen; the domain allows letters, digits, dots, and hyphens; and the top-level label is at least two letters.

patterns.name: url
patterns.summary: Matches an http(s) URL with scheme, host, optional port/path/query/fragment.
patterns.documentation: Captures `http://` or `https://` followed by an authority (host plus optional port), optional path, query string, and fragment. Conforms to the generic URI syntax.

patterns.name: uuid
patterns.summary: Matches a UUID in the standard 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal format.
patterns.documentation: Default form accepts any UUID; the `version=4` variant additionally enforces the version nibble (`4`) and the variant nibble (`8`, `9`, `a`, or `b`) for RFC 4122 v4 IDs.

patterns.name: ip
patterns.summary: Matches an IPv4 or IPv6 address (`version=4`/`version=6` to restrict).
patterns.documentation: Default form accepts both IPv4 dot-decimal and the full uncompressed IPv6 colon-hex form. Pass `version=4` or `version=6` to restrict to a single family.

patterns.name: dateTime
patterns.summary: Matches an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime stamp.
patterns.documentation: Matches `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` with optional fractional seconds and an optional `Z` or `±HH:MM` timezone designator.
